text.hero-copy: FØMØ Studio creates concept films and difficult-to-produce brand visuals—combining creative direction, AI-assisted production and professional post-production.
text.section-intro: Campaign concepts, product worlds and brand stories for agencies and ambitious marketing teams.
text.disclosure: Independent concept films and product studies. Brand examples are self-initiated work, not commissioned campaigns or endorsements.
text.services-copy: A creative production partner for advertising, branding and social agencies, and established brands with an ambitious brief. We develop the concept, explore the visual possibilities and finish the film with professional editorial, motion design, color and sound.
text.copy-4: Turn a creative brief into a visual treatment, pitch film or campaign concept.
text.copy-6: Distinctive storytelling shaped around your brand, audience and campaign.
text.copy-8: Explore difficult-to-produce product settings and visual ideas, with product fidelity reviewed throughout.
text.copy-10: Editing, motion graphics, color and sound bring the work together for delivery.
text.copy-13: We define the audience, business goal, message and practical constraints.
text.copy-15: Treatment, script, storyboard and reference frames establish the direction.
text.copy-17: We combine AI-assisted production with design and compositing, reviewing consistency shot by shot.
text.copy-19: Editorial, motion design, sound, color and delivery turn experiments into work.
text.offer: Request a free 5-second watermarked concept before commissioning a full project.
